prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, a 16-cell stone-only grid body (8 rows, two columns), every cell physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in yamanba makeup — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long teased neon pink and lime hair, a bold cheeky grin. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big neon-acrylic hoop and a small silver star stud.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest, a cinched waist above a big soft rounded belly and enormous round hips, body divided into a 16-cell grid (8 rows, two columns), each cell a different stone variant, stepped seams.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Below the collarbones, her body is divided into a grid of 16 cells — 8 horizontal rows stacked top to bottom, crossed by one vertical line down the centre splitting each row into a left and right cell — each cell with a raised stepped edge and shadow at every border, no gaps, no skin anywhere, every cell a genuinely different variant of the same stone material family. Row 1 (her whole left arm and left chest / her whole right arm and right chest): left cell carved solid vivid sky-blue turquoise with dark matrix veining, completely opaque; right cell carved solid banded green malachite with concentric rings, completely opaque. Row 2 (left / right body band 2): left cell carved solid deep grey labradorite that flashes blue-green light, completely opaque; right cell carved solid bright blue-green amazonite streaked with white feldspar, completely opaque. Row 3 (left / right body band 3): left cell carved solid banded black and white onyx, completely opaque; right cell carved solid deep royal-blue lapis lazuli with golden pyrite flecks, completely opaque. Row 4 (left / right body band 4): left cell carved solid polished black obsidian with faint internal swirls, completely opaque; right cell carved solid white Carrara marble veined with soft grey streaks, completely opaque. Row 5 (left / right body band 5): left cell carved solid golden-brown tiger's eye with a silky chatoyant band, completely opaque; right cell carved solid deep blue sodalite with fine white veining, completely opaque. Row 6 (left / right body band 6): left cell carved solid reddish-brown jasper with fine banding, completely opaque; right cell carved solid soft pink rhodochrosite with white banding, completely opaque. Row 7 (left / right body band 7): left cell carved solid mottled blue-green chrysocolla, completely opaque; right cell carved solid mottled green and pink unakite, completely opaque. Row 8 (left thigh-stub tip / right thigh-stub tip): left cell carved solid sparkling green aventurine, completely opaque, rounding off at its tip; right cell carved solid sparkling golden-orange sunstone, completely opaque, rounding off at its tip.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm golden amber on one side and a deep charcoal grey on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so amber light glances off one side and grey light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam in the grid. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
